steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Now that this is settled, the three clans must start liaising frequently with one another.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We must further discuss the specific of the transfer of powers to the Saintess and what powers each family is allowed to keep.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, aside from this, the preparations the three of us must make for the ritual are equally important.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Therefore, with the upcoming ceremony, I propose we seize the occasion and transfer our powers to the Saintess at the same time.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The ceremony and the transfer of powers are managed by different individuals. As such, both can be conducted at the same time. What's more, the ceremony also calls for the participation of the clan leaders. What do you think of the idea, if I may so ask?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The decision has been made. It will happen in due course.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: This year's ceremony will also be a ceremony for the transfer of powers to the Saintess, huh? Guess we have something to look forward to.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: In that case, I will have my men draft the relevant documents and distribute them across Kjerag.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: I am sure the masses will be rejoiced to learn of this.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Is something the matter?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You can't hoodwink your way out of this, Enciodes. Who will manage the valleys and the mines the next few days? Gnosis was in charge, but you had him fired. Who will take care of all that?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You needn't worry, Arctosz.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I hired an expert from outside Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This expert will conduct a field investigation on the valley and the mine from a disease prevention perspective and construct a medical facility within Silverash territory.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I will put this person in complete control of the two areas.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Look at the time. The train should be arriving in Karlan right about now. If you two would like to meet the expert, you need only wait a short moment longer.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Enough of this nonsense! I have no idea who you hired and what you are planning with this medical charade. However...!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: This so called 'expert' of yours will stay within my sight at all times!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is my guest you're talking about, Arctosz.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That's exactly why, Enciodes.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You said the overmining was Gnosis's doing, and I couldn't care less whether that's the case or not.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The way I see it, anyone you hire might as well be another Gnosis. We may be rid of one, but there will always be more.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You want to leave your men in charge of the place? Fine, but you will have to show me what this expert is capable of.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If your expert does well, then not only will they be your guest, Enciodes, I vow to welcome them with my warmest hospitality as my own guest.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What's the matter? You were talking so big. Do you really need so much time to think?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If everything is as you said, what is there to hesitate about? Or do you mean to tell us this person you hired is indeed another Gnosis, here to do your dirty work again?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Paleroches have always been in charge of the Vine-Bead Court's security. Now that I've agreed to turn these lands over to the Court, I cannot be more reassured with the Paleroches looking after them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That said...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: A word of advice, Arctosz. You'd best be careful. Entertaining this guest of ours will be no walk in the park.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hah, not a problem. There are no guests we Paleroches cannot 'entertain.'

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: —Let's find out whether this guest is as stiff-necked as you.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Sciurus, I need you to look into this guest.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Having me run your errands again?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'm not in the mood for your sharp tongue.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Grr.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Monch, Monch!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Monch here.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Get me a car!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan, go!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Please watch your step, Madame.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Valais... What's your view on all this?

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I'm afraid I'm not capable enough to see Enciodes's intent.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I don't blame you, but I certainly didn't expect that crafty woman Ratatos to agree to it. I don't get it.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: It's Matriarch Ratatos. I'm sure she has her ideas.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmph, all I know is that Silverash brat has to be planning something.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: And he may sound like he has a point, but I will never believe anything he says so easily!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Tell Gulo to 'invite' Enciodes's guest over. We'll figure out what to do later.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Yessir.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Man, I didn't expect it to start snowing the moment we got off the train.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, let's wait till it stops before we head up the mountain.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: This actually isn't so bad. We get snowstorms like this in Kjerag all the time.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Actually, that sounds like fun...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But we still have a long way to go. We should save our strength.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Eh... It's kind of a pain to get to Karlan right now.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I hope the train will take us all the way to the foot of the mountain one day.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: We may call this the Karlan Railway, but there's actually a stretch of distance from the station to the foot of the mountain where we aren't allowed to build anything.

options: They still aren't allowed to build anything there?
Sounds like it's going to be difficult, then.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: There is a lot of resistance to the idea... I'm not too sure about this stuff, but I don't think it's going to be easy.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: A lot of the people here insist on walking every single step up Mount Karlan, thinking to do otherwise would be unfaithful, but I don't think Kjeragandr would mind.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: We Kjerag folk always keep faith in our hearts. How would taking a train straight to the mountain change any of that?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir Enciodes has always wanted to have the railway go straight to Karlan.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Alas, the lands up ahead belong to the Paleroches.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir Arctosz would never let him build any tracks there.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Half a year ago, there was even a bit of a tussle between General Gulo of the Paleroches and Gnosis.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: With Gnosis?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Oh, right, I haven't heard anything about him for a while. Is he doing okay?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: He... He was fired because of that scuffle.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: One of the reasons Sir Enciodes invited the Doctor here is because he wanted the Doctor to fill his role.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Huh? How come no one told me that?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, did anyone...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: What's the matter...? Who are you people?!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Lady Ensia...! Get behind me!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: On Sir Arctosz's orders, I'm here to extend the Silverashes' guest, {@nickname}, an invitation to the Arctosz estate.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: You're bringing all these soldiers along to invite OUR guest to your place? What kind of sick joke is this?!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: This place belongs to my family, the Silverashes! General Gulo, you may work for the Paleroches, but I suggest you don't do anything out of line.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: I see you're here as well, Lady Ensia. You'll have to pardon me for my intrusion.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'll cut to the chase. Dr. {@nickname} is the Silverashes' guest, and you aren't bringing anyone along on your way home. Not on my watch.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Relax, Lady Ensia. Sir Arctosz only wanted to invite the esteemed guest to pay our humble abode a visit.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: As if my brother would agree to something that unreasonable!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Not to worry, Lady Ensia. Your brother... Sir Enciodes has already given us his approval.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: No way!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: It's true.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Also, Lady Ensia, mentioned the ownership of the land here...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: —This isn't Silverash territory anymore.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: From now on, the land belongs to the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Come again?!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Weiss, what's the meaning of this? First, it's the reason the Doctor was invited here. Then, it's the ownership of the lands. What else are you keeping from me?!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sorry, Lady Ensia...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Weiss, come on... what's happening?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Which one of you is {@nickname}?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: The one in the hood... Right, it's you.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Hm? I'm pretty sure I'm looking for someone in a hood...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: No way, it's gotta be you!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: If it's not you, then keep your mouth shut!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Wait, hold on! With that hood... It's gotta be you!

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: ...(Breathes a long sigh)

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: If you say so...

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: Don't move! Hands off your weapons!

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior B
steps.text: Last warning. No funny moves...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: You don't seem very happy about our arrangement?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Know your place, outsider. Sir Arctosz gave you an 'invitation.' Most people are never so lucky.
You dare act so impudent, knowing that's an esteemed guest who stands before you?
You hear footsteps accompanied by dull, metallic clanking sounds. An impressively tall woman walks toward you.
Immediately, everything falls silent. The Kjerag soldiers surrounding you put away their weapons and step aside with timid looks on their faces.
She takes a quick glance at all of you, briefly pausing as her gaze lands on the elite operator standing next to you.
The moment their eyes meet, they put their hands on their weapons by pure instinct.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I assume you will do whatever it takes to get this 'Doctor' to pay your visit today?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: We have our orders, and Sir Enciodes gave us his approval... You shouldn't have a problem with that?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Relax. I'm not here for you.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Lady Ensia, Enciodes asked me to escort you home.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Degenbrecher, did my brother really...?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm here to receive our guest for Enciodes, and I've done that now.

options: And you'll hand me over to these guys right straight away?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Please, go on.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Looks like Sir Enciodes is so busy that he doesn't have the time to come fetch the Doctor himself?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Put your weapon down. I would rather not offend our guest's bodyguard in any way.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: It's part of my job to carry a weapon at all times, and you're not my boss.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I'm the Doctor's bodyguard. Wherever the Doctor goes, I go.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: My instructions are to invite the Doctor, and the Doctor alone.

options: It's okay, Sharp. You go stand by somewhere else.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: If you say so...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, are you seriously going?

options: Hell yeah. This sounds like fun.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Don't worry? How am I supposed to not worry? And why are you even going along with what they're saying, Doctor?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But if it wasn't for us inviting you in the first place, this wouldn't have happened... Why are you going along with this so easily? I still haven't been told a thing...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, stop grinning. You're reminding me of my brother... And why are you going along with this? I don't get it...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Gulo.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You'd do well to treat our guest better than that.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Say 'please.'

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Doctor of Rhodes Island... 'Please' follow us to the Paleroche estate.

options: The Black Knight is so well-mannered.
Three-time champion of the Kazimierz Major.
The Leithanian warrior who needs not use Arts.
Your name still has legs in Kazimierz.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm just Enciodes's bodyguard.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Looks like I'm working overtime again.

a.text: At the Tri-Clan Council that just concluded, the Vine-Bead Court and the clans have come to a shocking understanding regarding the Karlan mining question.

To resolve the differences between the families and to better drive Kjerag's development, the clans have all agreed to turn portions of their authority over to the Saintess, in accordance with the teachings of Kjeragandr.

Moreover, the clans have all agreed to fully assist the Saintess in her role as the leader in service of leading Kjerag toward a better tomorrow.
......

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Enciodes!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You're home, Ensia.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You've traveled far, my dear sister.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Enciodes, why?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Slow down.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Why did you hand the Doctor over to the Paleroches?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I need the Doctor to carry some of Gnosis's responsibilities for me, and as you know, the relationship between Karlan Trade and the Paleroches has been tense.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Arctosz demanded that the Doctor operate under his supervision, and it's a reasonable ask.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Then why didn't you tell the Doctor?! Not even I knew about this arrangement!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It happened after I had the invitation sent out.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But still...!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I know Rhodes Island saved you, and I know you think very highly of the Doctor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Trust me, Ensia, I think of the Doctor no less highly than you do.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If the Doctor comes to harm there, the Paleroches will pay the price.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: No, Enciodes... I'm not just a Silverash. I'm an employee of Rhodes Island. I have a responsibility to ensure the Doctor's safety.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Leave that to me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You've grown up, Ensia.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let's do this, then. Matterhorn.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Have someone keep an eye on what's going happening over there.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As soon as the Doctor begins work in the valleys and mines, you may take Ensia to see the Doctor.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Very good, Sir.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Enciodes!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Go, Ensia. Rest well.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Master, about the Doctor...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Matterhorn, make sure Ensia is safe.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I... I will.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It's useless, you know.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: She isn't the kind of girl we can keep inside the house.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'll keep an eye on her.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I need you on standby.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: So be it, then.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Speaking of which, how much do you know about this Doctor of Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: An excellent scholar of outstanding professionalism who understands the profits that Rhodes Island will see from working with me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That the Doctor so quickly got the grasp of the situation and accepted the arrangement shows that I was correct in my assessment. Why do you ask?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I don't think this Doctor is merely a 'scholar.' Great at sniffing things out, no doubt, and much more so than you expected, too.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: And besides, this Doctor sends you regards.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You think the Doctor foresaw all this?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I sensed not a bit of surprise under that hood. Not only did this scholar of yours understand the situation completely, there was never even a hint of astonishment, and I must emphasize that.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What's more, apparently my reputation precedes me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Looks like our friend came prepared.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Trust my intuition, Enciodes. I have an eye for people.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You might've made yourself an enemy with this move of yours.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: An enemy?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No, if the intel I gathered and your description are correct, then the Doctor will become my dearest friend... or should I say, I will become the Doctor's dearest friend?

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Sir Enciodes, it's time for your meeting.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let's go.

a.text: Tsk, what's Gnosis doing here? He never showed his face at meetings like this.
Hmph, I heard the one they hired to clean up his mess is finally here. I bet he couldn't bear with the shame any longer and came to beg the boss for mercy.
Haven't you heard? Gnosis's replacement was taken away by the Paleroches. The way I see it, he's here to try his luck, thinking he's still got a chance.
Impossible. There's no chance at all.

steps.text: Gnosis sits quietly in the conference room.
Everyone sits far away from him, but their gossip echoes through the room, clear as day.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Gnosis, it's been a while. You've lost weight.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Thanks to you, Mr. President.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We spent four years in Victoria together. It pains me to see things turn out this way.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes, you've thrown me under the bus already. Let's skip the pleasantries.

steps.name: Mid-level Manager
steps.text: Gnosis, you prick, don't you know who you're talking to?!

steps.name: Mid-level Manager
steps.text: If it wasn't for your friendship with the president, you wouldn't even be allowed to stand here now that you're sacked!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I don't remember needing anyone's permission to stand here.

steps.name: Mid-level Manager
steps.text: How dare you!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Gnosis, there is no doubt that Karlan Trade owes much to you for its establishment and growth.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, whether you have a right to be here or not... that is not for you to say.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Uncle Chester, please.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: First, regarding the sentencing of Karlan Trade's former chief technical officer Gnosis Edelweiss.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: There is no doubt that the expansion of the valleys and mines under Gnosis Edelweiss's management has brought the company tremendous profit.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: But, on the other hand, the rapid expansion strategy and the secret mining of Karlan has brought the company under the repeated scrutiny of the Tri-Clan Council.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: In particular, when the other clans asked to participate in the valley's investigation, Gnosis planned to ambush the two clans' inspection team.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: This has severely damaged Karlan Trade's image and the Silverashes' standing in the Tri-Clan Council.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Therefore, President Enciodes has decided that, effective today, Gnosis Edelweiss will be formally terminated as a Karlan Trade employee.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: So that's why you had me come. You wanted to read all these criticisms you have for me out loud in front of everyone.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Your actions have brought harm to Karlan Trade's profits. This is how I answer our stakeholders. I hope you can understand.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Very well... Enciodes.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I would never have imagined all those years ago when I came to Kjerag to build this place up with you that this is how it would all end.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am sure both you and I agree that it's far more important to do what's reasonable and beneficial than look back on old times.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That said, I will leave you your lab. You are free to keep using it as soon as any sensitive Karlan Trade data has been removed.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I could also arrange for you to join a caravan heading for Victoria, if that's what you prefer.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I have to answer to all the stakeholders here. Likewise, I have to give you an answer.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If you think what you are doing is reasonable, then I feel nothing but disappointment in you.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Karlan Trade yet needs my technology, and Kjerag's industrial sector has not come so far that it can progress without importing core technologies from the outside world.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You promised me a suitably large stage and backed my research, so that we can break new ground in these promising snowlands for the welfare of the people of Kjerag.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: In the end, this is where my stage is, and I am being thrown under the bus for this company.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I still approve of your achievements in academic research, Gnosis.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That is why, more so than anyone, I'm hoping that you could reflect on what you have done.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You should never have let things out of my control.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Hmph, are you so weak now that you're scared of letting anything out of your iron grip?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If that doesn't open my eyes!
A loud bang reverberates throughout the room. Gnosis slams the conference room's door shut with enough force that the gust of wind sends paper flying through the air.
Shocked by the sudden thunderclap, the spectators all instinctively look toward the source of the sound before casting their heads down under the invisible pressure.
No one knows just what expression Enciodes holds at this moment.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let's continue, Chester.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: As requested by Sir Arctosz, the leader of Rhodes Island, Dr. {@nickname}, will be in charge of the transfer of the valleys and mines under the protection of the Paleroches.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: We will formally introduce the Doctor to everyone at the company once all the tasks at hand are complete.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Onto our next topic, the meat of our meeting today.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: The preliminary discussions on how to partition the company's power and hand it over to the Saintess.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: First off, on the matter of tariffs...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What do I call you, outsider?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Funny name.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Valais told me Enciodes's people call you the Doctor. That's what I'll call you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Doctor? Sounds just like the scholars over at the academy.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Doctor, do you know why you're here?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmph, Enciodes wants you to take Gnosis's place, but I don't trust his people. That's why I'm keeping my eye on you.

options: I didn't know that was part of my job description.
Enciodes didn't fill me in on the details...
I'm just here on vacation. You got the wrong person, I'm telling you.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Sir, I'm pretty sure we got a smartass playing dumb here.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmph, you're Enciodes's 'guest.' Even if you really don't know a thing, you're still Enciodes's people.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmph, I invited you here because I didn't want him to fill you in on anything.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Please stop playing dumb.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Considering Sir Enciodes invited you now, of all times, no one will believe that you came to Kjerag for mere sightseeing.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Valais, tell our guest the deal.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Sir Enciodes has decided to transfer the valley and the mines to the Vine-Bead Court. The man who was in charge of the mines and the factory was his subordinate, Gnosis.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: And ever since Gnosis was dismissed, the coordinator position has been left vacant.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: According to Sir Enciodes, you are his replacement.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Looks like you have a clear understanding of the situation now.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Until I am sure that Enciodes isn't making any funny moves in the mines and the valleys, you aren't leaving this place.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Don't you even think about pulling any tricks yourself. My men don't care about etiquette nearly as much as Enciodes's people.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If they want your head, there's nothing I can do to stop them.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Hah, boss, look at this squirt. I wouldn't know where to chop if I were to try my blade on this midget.

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors
steps.text: Hahahahaha!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmph, shut up, all of you. I'm not going to make things too hard for you, outsider.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: In the end, you're Enciodes's guest. As long as you play along, we won't do anything to you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Am I making myself clear?

options: I'm not worried. All of you look like reasonable people to me.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Enough, Valais. Show our guest to the bedroom.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Very good, Sir.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Enya, I'm coming in.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I knew it... You're still sleeping.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Enya. Enya, rise and shine.

steps.name: Sleepyhead Enya
steps.text: Uhh.... Huh?

steps.name: Sleepyhead Enya
steps.text: Morn.
After a brief fuss, Enya gets dressed and sits in front of her dressing table. Kjarr naturally stands behind her and combs her hair.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: What's the matter now?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You know.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Isn't it a good thing to become leader of all three clans?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You always say that, in the Vine-Bead Court, your role is simply to keep the masses calm, and most of the time, it's actually the Great Elder who calls the shots.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: This is an opportunity.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I wouldn't be so worried if it had been Arctosz or even Ratatos who brought up the idea.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But it was Enciodes who made that proposal.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Perhaps the guilt's suddenly gotten to him?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I sure hope so.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But if you're so worried about this, couldn't you have turned it down?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Didn't you agree to it without thinking twice?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That's because there wasn't a point to dragging it out.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No one had any grounds to object.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It doesn't matter whether he really wants me to be Kjerag's leader. There wasn't anyone who could reject the proposal then and there.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And if we had set the issue aside, more people would've found out.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You told me that the masses have gotten used to peace, just like they've gotten used to the endless snow on the mountains.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The people of Kjerag wish for peace first and foremost, and they gravitate toward those who can bring them peace.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Right, peace. Whether it's the peace that Enciodes brought them or the peace that the Vine-Bead Court brought.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That's why, even if I turned down the offer, the people would've asked me to accept.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: So I might as well take the initiative myself before the Great Elder makes all the arrangements.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You think Enciodes foresaw that?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: He made a proposal that no one could refuse. Under normal circumstances, he would've been the last person to suggest this.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I am sure both Arctosz and Ratatos thought the same thing.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I can see why Arctosz went along with it, but Ratatos... She was never the kind of person to give up easily.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What a headache. I really hope Kjeragandr will hear my prayers and teach the Great Elder and the three clan leaders a good lesson.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Perhaps She has already heard your prayers, and it just isn't time yet.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Do you want Her to take care of Enciodes too?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: For him, as cruel as possible.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Pff.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Now let's put this necklace on you... and we're done!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Mmhmm.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Right, would you give this letter and scarf to Ensia? Also...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Ask her to come pay the mountain a visit, right?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You know me well.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Also, send the word out that I'll be analyzing scriptures today, and I don't want to be disturbed.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I... I need some time to think.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Of course.
After Kjarr leaves the room, Enya opens her drawer to see an exquisitely decorated base, holding an eye-catching, elegant rock.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: O Kjeragandr, please guide me. What should I do?
We no longer live in times where isolation is enough to keep ourselves out of the affairs around us.
In the past hundred years, there have been countless exchanges and conflicts between nations. Columbia rose quickly in a conflict, while Gaul, a powerful country, was also wiped out in a conflict.
All the world's nations are slowly changing in these times separated by Catastrophes. Refusing relations with others is no longer an option.
Kjerag cannot continue to lock itself away on these snowy mounts. Kjeragandr's protection—if Kjeragandr really exists in the first place—can bring the Snow Realm this far.
If we are to go any further, Kjerag must grow stronger than ever before.
The millennium of peace and quiet has reached its end, and we cannot wait for others to open the door for us.
Kjerag needs to make contact with the outside world. We must take that step forward while we still have control. That's the Silverash tradition.
Kjerag must remain Kjerag. We still have a chance, but time grows short for the snowy mountains.
I have seen our world... I have to make a difference. Everything I've witnessed needs to have meaning.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: So you are Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Do you know who I am?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Sciurus Browntail, sister of the Browntail clan matriarch, Ratatos Browntail.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You know that, and you have the balls to forgo a salute?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Why must I salute someone whom I have nothing to do with?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You! Don't you know your manners?!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If we must talk manners, you should work on yours first, Sciurus Browntail.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I heard all your commotion outside the door. What's more, when nobles meet, they must each first curtsey to each other with a Karlan bow.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If you show up here without affording me any courtesy, why should I show you any?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: J-Just how outdated is your idea of etiquette?!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Etiquette never dies. It's only slowly forgotten. As a noble, you should feel sorrow in that.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: The Edelweisses have long been in charge of the management of Kjerag's texts and records. I admire your knowledge of Kjerag etiquette, Mr. Gnosis.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Still though, I'm afraid Madame Sciurus isn't here to discuss Kjerag etiquette. Could we please move on to the main topic?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Very well. I'm curious. Considering Ratatos refused my capitulation, why is she now reaching out to me?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph, do you have to ask?! It's because your master proposed handing his powers over to the Saintess at the Tri-Clan Council!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I see. In that case...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Go home and tell Ratatos. Now that things have come to this, I am likely not the only one who will cooperate, given the right amount of sincerity.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Per Sir Arctosz's orders, please stay here while you are not attending to your duties.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: If you need to head outside, we will serve as your bodyguards. Kjerag may be a safe place, but we cannot guarantee no one will take the chance to cause trouble.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: You will be served the finest delicacies that Kjerag has to offer. You may also use anything here as you see fit. All your daily needs will be met during your stay with us.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: If you require anything, please let the servants know. You may also have them relay anything to me.

options: Very well. I look forward to dinner.
(Keeping an eye on me whenever I head out, huh...?)

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Oripathy consultation... and the Grand Ceremony... Are those the only reasons my brother is inviting you to the Snow Realm?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Oh, the Grand Ceremony takes place annually in Kjerag. It's the biggest event, and the most important thing to the Kjerag people.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: On that day, everyone in Kjerag stops what they're doing and offers Kjeragandr, the goddess of our mountains, our most sincere prayers.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: We pray for a happy, peaceful year under our mountain goddess's protection.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: As for the Oripathy problem, Kjerag didn't have many Infected in the past, so most of us don't know much about Oripathy. In the Snow Realms, Oripathy is far from the greatest threat we face.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But ever since my brother got the mountains connected by railway, we've been getting more and more visitors, and life has also gotten much better. Thanks to that, everyone's starting to learn more about the Infected and Oripathy.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I guess Oripathy's stepping into the limelight since there are no other pressing issues.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Kjerag still doesn't have any professional means to test for Oripathy, let alone helping the Infected get settled and get treatment.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Given the situation, you might be the best consultant they can get.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, are you going to accept the invitation?

options: That's not something I can decide all by myself.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Right, you have a lot on your plate right now, but still...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I know it's not easy to make a decision when this invitation came out of nowhere, but still...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Personally, I really want you to go.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: My parents died in an accident when I was still a kid...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: And after they died, my brother, Enciodes, took over their business to support the family.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: He kept us afloat all by himself until I came of age. Then, to ensure our family's future, he left Kjerag to study in Victoria.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Our family was already on pretty shaky ground before he left Kjerag, and that was around when he started getting more and more headstrong...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But at least we all still got along well as siblings.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But things changed ever since he came back and started Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Both my brother and sister treated me very well, but, for some reason, the two of them started talking less, and their relationship soured.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Five years ago, when the last Saintess passed away, my sister joined the trials and became the new Kjerag Saintess.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: She's rarely left Mount Karlan since, and I haven't had a lot of chances to see her. We only write to each other now.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: And ever since she became the Saintess, it feels like my brother's often at odds with her...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I may be very good at mountain climbing, but I wouldn't know where to start to mend relationships.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But you're really amazing, Doctor. You get along with everyone, and you've solved a lot of problems for people.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: That's why I was thinking that... if we ever had the chance, maybe you could help me come up with ideas...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, I guess this might seem weird coming from me...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But I know my brother better than anyone else. He's amazing, but he's the kind of person who doesn't mind doing whatever it takes to achieve his goals.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'm actually a little worried that you'll end up becoming a pawn in his game, if you go.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: So that's why it's okay if you don't want to!

options: I'll bear with it for the now.

steps.text: That's why I told you you should've gotten out while you still could.
Look at you now. You're caught.

options: Are you the one who talked to me at the market?

steps.text: Exactly.
Huh? You can hear me, right?
Hey, listen!
I could ask you the same, calm outsider.
The entire time you've been here, you haven't even showed the tiniest bit of worry. Did you know this was going to happen?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Call me Kjera.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: I changed my mind. I want to be friends with you.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Would you like to be friends with me?

options: I don't make friends with shady people.
Why don't you tell me what this talking rock is all about first?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Don't you think it's better for me to maintain a mysterious aura?

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Sorry, I'm writing a letter to somebody else right now, so I can't go anywhere. Perhaps another time.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Hmm... That's classified information!

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: Well, I don't really have so much time to keep bothering you, if you really don't want to talk.

steps.name: Kjera
steps.text: But it's not so bad to have somebody to talk to, don't you think?
